note: The Bank of Bhutan's service charges: a savings account's maintenance fee is 150 ngultrum a year, charged at 75 in June and 75 in December, with no minimum balance required. The Bhutan National Bank's savings account (150 ngultrum a year) is open only to Bhutanese nationals and isn't written.

sources.title: Bank of Bhutan, Service Charges
sources.said: Savings account ... Annual Account Maintenance Fee: Nu. 150 per year, charged semi-annually at Nu. 75 in June and Nu. 75 in December. The fee applies to all accounts, irrespective of the account opening date and minimum balance not required

sources.title: Bhutan National Bank, Savings Account
sources.said: All Bhutanese nationals above the age of 15 years can open and operate a savings deposit account. ... Annual account maintenance fee of Nu. 150.00 only
